subject: museum crowd
title: The 5 Most-Visited Museums on Earth, Ranked (#3 Isn't in Europe)

scenes.text: The world's busiest museum gets nine million visitors a year. Number three surprises everyone.
Number five: the Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York. About six million visitors last year.
scenes.label: The Met · 6.0 million

scenes.text: Number four: the British Museum in London. Around six point four million, and entry is free.
scenes.label: British Museum · 6.4 million

scenes.text: Number three: the National Museum of Korea in Seoul. Six point five million, more than London.
scenes.label: Museum of Korea · 6.5 million

scenes.text: Number two: the Vatican Museums. Almost seven million people, many there for the Sistine Chapel.
scenes.label: Vatican Museums · 6.9 million

scenes.text: Number one: the Louvre in Paris. Over nine million visitors in a single year.
scenes.label: Louvre · 9.0 million

description:
The five most-visited museums in The Art Newspaper's 2025 survey: the Metropolitan Museum of Art (5.98 million, main building), the British Museum (6.44 million), the National Museum of Korea (6.51 million), the Vatican Museums (6.93 million) and the Louvre (9.05 million).
Which of these have you visited?
first_comment: Which museum would you put at number one, and what should we rank next?
